# First, set P0 to match (2,1) - currently it matches (0,0), need to press UP once
# Then explore P1 states

cur_ascii = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')

def get_p_symbol(ascii_lines, si):
    inner_col = 15 + si * 7
    return tuple(ascii_lines[51+dr][inner_col:inner_col+5] for dr in range(1, 6))

def get_p_cells(ascii_lines):
    centers = [(7, 25), (7, 48), (16, 25), (16, 48), (25, 25), (25, 48)]
    cells = {}
    for idx, (cr, cc) in enumerate(centers):
        row, col = idx // 2, idx % 2
        pat = tuple(ascii_lines[cr+dr][cc-2:cc+3] for dr in range(-2, 3))
        cells[(row, col)] = pat
    return cells

p_cells = get_p_cells(cur_ascii)

# Set P0 to match (2,1) by pressing UP
action(['UP'])

cur_ascii2 = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
p0 = get_p_symbol(cur_ascii2, 0)
for (r,c), pcell in p_cells.items():
    if p0 == pcell:
        print(f"P0 now matches ({r},{c})")
        break

# Now explore P1 states - move to P1, cycle through UP
action(['RIGHT'])  # Move to P1

p1_states = []
for i in range(10):
    state = get_p_symbol(current_frame.ascii.split('\n'), 1)
    if state in p1_states:
        print(f"\nP1 cycle detected at step {i}, cycle length = {i - p1_states.index(state)}")
        break
    p1_states.append(state)
    for (r,c), pcell in p_cells.items():
        if state == pcell:
            print(f"P1 state {i}: matches ({r},{c})")
            break
    else:
        print(f"P1 state {i}: no match")
    action(['UP'])

print(f"\nP1 has {len(p1_states)} unique states")

# Reset P1 to first state by going back DOWN
for _ in range(len(p1_states) - 1):
    action(['DOWN'])

# Move back to P0
action(['LEFT'])

# Now explore P2
action(['RIGHT', 'RIGHT'])  # Move to P2

p2_states = []
for i in range(10):
    state = get_p_symbol(current_frame.ascii.split('\n'), 2)
    if state in p2_states:
        print(f"\nP2 cycle detected at step {i}, cycle length = {i - p2_states.index(state)}")
        break
    p2_states.append(state)
    for (r,c), pcell in p_cells.items():
        if state == pcell:
            print(f"P2 state {i}: matches ({r},{c})")
            break
    else:
        print(f"P2 state {i}: no match")
    action(['UP'])

print(f"\nP2 has {len(p2_states)} unique states")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
